system.description: Spend a Hope to imbue corpse parts, loose bones and grave-litter into a shambling monstrosity that obeys basic commands. Make a Spellcast Roll to command it to take action. When necessary, it shares your Evasion and traits and its attacks deal 1d10+5 physical damage. You can only maintain one Horror at a time, and it falls apart when it takes more damage than your Severe Threshold in a single blow.
